QuestInfo.name: Letter for Lucas
QuestInfo.parent: Please bring this letter to Lucas
QuestInfo.0: Maria needs someone to help her...
QuestInfo.1: Maria needs someone to help her. She wants you to deliver a latter to Lucas in Amherst.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered Maria's letter to Lucas in Amherst.

0.0: I'm getting anxious. I need to get this letter to #p12000# fast. It's urgent! But I have things to do here so I can't leave this spot...
0.1: Can you take this #bletter#k to #r#p12000##k in #b#m1010000##k? It'll only take a minute...

yes.0: 들어주시는 거예요? 다행이다... 이제야 한숨 돌릴 수 있겠군요. 여기 제 #b편지#k 받으세요. 그리고 이 편지를 #b#m1010000##k에 있는 장로님께 전해주세요.
yes.1: #b#m1010000##k는 여기서 북동쪽으로 가다 보면 있답니다. #p12000#님은 #m1010000#의 장로님이시죠. 아마 오늘도 잡화상점 앞에서 산책을 하고 계실 거예요. #b#p12000##k님의 #b답장#k을 꼬옥 받아와 주세요.

no.0: Ahhhh, this is not good. If I don't get this to the town chief... Please reconsider!

npc.0: You haven't met #r#p12000##k in #m1010000# yet? Please bring him my letter. It's urgent.

item.0: #b#p2103##k에게서 편지가 올때가 되었는데... 무슨 일이 생긴 건가? 이거 원. 누군가 소식을 전해줬으면 하는데...

lost.0: You lost my letter! Be more careful! Good thing I made a copy. This time, be more careful!
